data.nothing_is_installed: lemonfiber does not install anything on your device and cannot. What is here is where to look and what to choose; the installing is yours.
data.only_at_home: All of this works on your home network and nowhere else. Away from the house, none of these apps will find the server — that is how it is meant to be for now, not a fault.

causes.because: The address is wrong, or it has changed.
causes.fix: Check it against what lemonfiber front-door says now. That address is read from this machine at the moment of asking, so a machine that was renamed answers differently from the note somebody wrote down.
causes.tell: Every device fails the same way, including one that worked yesterday.

causes.because: The device is on a different network from the server.
causes.fix: Put it back on the home Wi-Fi. A phone that fell back to mobile data is the common one, and it looks like a broken address rather than a network it is on.
causes.tell: The device has working internet, and another device in the house can reach the server.

causes.fix: lemonfiber status says whether it is, and lemonfiber up starts it.
causes.tell: No device can reach it, and this is the one you can answer without leaving your chair.

trouble.symptom: The app cannot find the server

causes.because: Guest networks keep devices from reaching each other, which is what they are for.
causes.fix: Join the ordinary home network. There is nothing to change on the server: a guest network is doing its job.
causes.tell: The device has working internet and the address is right, and nothing answers — which looks exactly like a wrong address.

trouble.symptom: The device is on the guest Wi-Fi

causes.fix: A new library, or one whose files moved, has nothing until it is scanned. The media server scans on a schedule and can be told to now.

causes.because: The account has been given access to no library.
causes.fix: The account exists and can sign in — what it lacks is permission. Give it the libraries it should see in the media server's user settings.
causes.tell: Somebody else sees content and this person does not.

trouble.symptom: The library is empty after signing in

causes.because: The address changed and the app remembers the old one.
causes.fix: Change the saved server in the app to what lemonfiber front-door says now. Where an app offers no way to edit it, remove the server and add it again.
causes.tell: It stopped for everybody at once, and a browser opened at the current address still works.

trouble.symptom: It worked and now the app cannot connect
